name: NIGERIA

flag.title: Green & White
flag.note: Two green stripes, one white stripe

lead: Nigeria has more people than any other country in Africa. One in six Africans lives here! Rainforest in the south turns into dry savanna in the north. Nigeria gave the world Afrobeats music, Nollywood films and jollof rice.
geo: Two great rivers, the Niger and the Benue, meet in the middle like a giant letter Y. The south is thick rainforest. The north is dry grassland baking in the sun.
In the far north-east, Lake Chad is slowly shrinking. In the south, the Niger Delta is a maze of creeks and mangroves. It is one of Earth's largest river deltas.
animals: Nigeria's forests have forest elephants, chimpanzees and the rare Cross River gorilla. Fewer than 300 gorillas are left, in misty hills near the Cameroon border.
Yankari National Park has hot springs and over 350 elephants, West Africa's best herd. Nile crocodiles and manatees live in its rivers.
culture: Nigeria has over 500 languages and 250 ethnic groups. The Hausa-Fulani, Yoruba and Igbo are the biggest three. Each group has its own festivals and clothes. Kano's Durbar is a big horse parade.
Nollywood makes about 2,500 films a year, second only to Bollywood. Afrobeats star Burna Boy fills stadiums worldwide. Nigerians insist their jollof rice beats every other country's.
history: The Nok people made clay sculptures 2,000 years ago. Later the Kanem-Bornu Empire and the Yoruba Kingdom of Oyo grew strong, long before Europeans arrived.
Britain colonised Nigeria in 1914. Independence came on 1 October 1960. A civil war ran from 1967 to 1970. Later, oil money helped Lagos grow into a megacity of 15 million.
wows: Nollywood makes more films a year than Hollywood.
Lagos is among the ten largest cities on Earth.
Nigeria is Africa's biggest oil producer and its largest economy.
Scientists track Cross River gorillas by their nose prints.
Money sent home by Nigerians abroad sometimes beats the country's oil income in a year.
The Benin Bronzes, cast here 500 years ago, are among the finest sculptures ever made.
More people speak English in Nigeria than in the United Kingdom.

myths.myth: Jollof rice was invented in Nigeria
myths.fact: It likely began with the Wolof people of Senegal. Many countries now cook their own versions.
Chimps are apes. Apes have no tails, and monkeys do.
